Overview

Salam is a city in Al Wusta with a population of 15,000. A coastal town in central Oman, known for its turtle nesting beaches at Ras al Jinz, traditional fishing communities, and pristine coastline. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
